capabilities: Review a selection, paragraph, or note against a calibration base of biases and fallacies
Refine review points with a connected LLM provider, or use a built-in fallback
Run a downloaded local calibration engine as a background service
Revise the original passage against points shown in a review panel
extras: Desktop only (macOS Apple Silicon or Windows x64); Intel Mac and Linux unsupported. The engine binary is downloaded from GitHub Releases (Alibaba OSS mirror) and registered as a background service that must be manually removed on uninstall.
intentEvidence: Forked from Smart Composer by Heesu Suh. KogCat keeps its multi-provider LLM client and settings scaffolding
motivation: The README contrasts KogCat with 'plain AI' advice-giving, arguing AI makes answers smoother while KogCat makes judgment sound.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to challenge a passage's reasoning against known cognitive biases or against the author's own past notes before committing to it.

relations.evidence: Forked from Smart Composer by Heesu Suh.

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, Perplexity, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Ollama or LM Studio for fully offline review; om-core engine binary downloaded on first launch

summary: AI-assisted judgment calibration that reviews selected text against a local knowledge base of cognitive biases, fallacies, and contradictions.
